Craving your favourite street food? Now you can enjoy all those delicious, chatpate flavours right at home! Bring the excitement of street food to your dinner table with three irresistible recipes that make the perfect homemade feast.
In this video, we're making:
Stuffed Aloo Tikki Chaat – Crispy potato tikkis filled with a spicy chana dal stuffing, topped with chole, sweetened curd and flavourful chutneys.
Combination Tawa Pulao – A delicious street-style rice dish cooked with vegetables, pav bhaji masala, butter and aromatic spices.
